protocol.purpose: Source recognition only; trained mixed-script derivative, not another base-model prompt trial.
protocol.runtime: Originalqwen_asr0.0.6 + Transformers4.57.6, isolatedtarget deps; FP16/SDPA conversion forT4. No claim of BF16 equivalence.
protocol.decoding: Greedy512, num_beams1, batch1, auto languageNone, no context/hints, no forcealigner. Full20s clips.
protocol.limits: Partlyunclear references, unknown prior exposure, RomanizedHindi reference, no full bilingual meaning. Uncertain opening/probably excluded; unintelligible65 excluded. No mixed/fullwindow WER or10% gate.
protocol.decision_rule: Reject any observed clear substantive error or source-script failure; formatting improvement alone cannot accept. Only consider downstream renderer after source improves.
protocol.guard: Own offline runtime,7GiBallocator,>=3072MiB free, sampled production health/image/start unchanged,1200s bound, cleanup afterrun.

precision_control.purpose: Before interpreting poor FP16 output as more than configuration failure, run one FP32 control on failed English control and checked travel-question clip.
precision_control.decoding: Unchanged greedy512, languageNone/contextempty, same full20s inputs.
precision_control.template_check: Rendered minimal messages match original base checkpoint byte for byte; five actual newlines, no literal backslash-n. No template change.
precision_control.bound: Exactly2additionalgenerations, same guard/cleanup, no other precision or prompt sweep.

fp16.precision: FP16 compute/weights converted from BF16 checkpoint; SDPA on T4

fp32.precision: FP32 control from same BF16 checkpoint; SDPA on T4

evaluation.method: Agent text comparison against existing independently supplied clear source spans. No direct audio perception or full bilingual meaning adjudication.

cases.fp16: Retains most checked English technical discussion, uncertainty and negation. Partly unclear incomplete reference prevents full-window accuracy gate; no acceptance from this one case.
Listener-confirmed English output becomes largely phonetic/translated Devanagari. Checked Atlas/signup-responsibility content is omitted. Fails source-script and substantive coverage requirements.
cases.fp32: Same script/coverage failure persists; no rescue.

cases.fp16: Keeps date but drops independently checked travel question/answer. Other new wording is not treated as verified source; uncertain opening and probably remain excluded. Fails substantive coverage.
cases.fp32: Exact same parsed output as FP16, including the missing question/answer.

cases.fp16: Some pricing/model-choice speech is phonetically recognizable, but English remains largely Devanagari with additional distortions. No faithful mixed-script Original Transcript. Unchecked amount/billing/Hindi meaning not adjudicated.

completion.interpretation: Missing content is not attributed to token-budget truncation; EOS does not establish completeness.

evaluation.template_check: Minimal rendered original checkpoint prompt matches base Qwen checkpoint exactly; actual newlines, no escaped-newline formatting repair applied.
evaluation.weight_finiteness: FP32 control asserted all model parameters finite before generation.
evaluation.wer_reason: Partial references with unclear spans and no common-script adjudication; no complete mixed-language/translation truth.
evaluation.decision: Reject tested Srota source-recognition configurations on these development cases. FP32 reproduces key failures; neither script-preservation nor semantic coverage is sufficient. No translation-stage pilot follows this failed source trial. Not a claim about every possible Srota deployment or future fine-tuning.

runtime.limitation: Bounded isolated batch1 coexistence with sampled production health; not a sustained-load capacity benchmark.
